input: Find churches that run weekly summer day camps (not just Vacation Bible School) for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Grace Fellowship Church of Johnson City
candidates.note: Pine Cove weeklong day camp for rising grades 1–6; June 28–July 2, 2027 announced.

candidates.name: First Christian Church of Johnson City
candidates.note: FCC Kids Day Camp ran June 9–13, 2025, for ages 4 through rising sixth graders.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Rutherfordton
candidates.note: Listed Summer Advocacy Camp August 3–6, 2026, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; ages not specified.
